name: Yuuki Kotoha
source:
Being the youngest daughter of an old and prominent family, she is prohibited from so much as touching a man prior to marriage.

However, she understands her fiancé has physical needs, so she orders Asato to "masturbate" using the body of her maid, rather than risk him cheating on her.

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_134.html#character]official site[/url]]
